title: Noble Beef and Rice Curry
description: A flavorful and aromatic curry dish made with noble beef and served with steaming hot rice.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the curry and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the noble beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes or until the beef is tender.
Add the Canadian rice to the pan and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 5 minutes or until the rice is heated through.
Serve hot and garnish with fresh cilantro, if desired.
